query: SELECT s.id, s.companyName, s.contactEmail, i.submittedAt, i.updatedAt, r.isArchived as rankingsArchived FROM sponsors s LEFT JOIN intakeSubmissions i ON s.id = i.sponsorId LEFT JOIN rankingsSubmissions r ON s.id = r.sponsorId WHERE s.companyName LIKE '%Harver%';
